methodology.reuseReason: The current native source remains byte-identical at D028. Previously measured D028 native and iOS artifacts were reused only after their actual bytes and SHA-256 values were verified; their original D028 provenance is unchanged. All 12 profile/configuration classes.jar rows were freshly compiled from the current Android packaging source.
methodology.android: Release CMake link followed by llvm-strip --strip-unneeded; native .so bytes are retained as a separate diagnostic.
methodology.androidSdk: Original Android SDK metric: per-ABI native .so + uncompressed classes.jar + uncompressed assets/aster-core.js when QuickJS is included; APK compression, R8 shrinking, and install/runtime overhead are excluded.
methodology.androidJavaOnly: All four profiles by three configurations were freshly compiled with offline Gradle :syncReleaseLibJars in isolated output directories; cargo and native publication tasks were explicitly excluded. Profile labels do not change Java compiler flags, but each report row has its own actual fresh classes.jar.
methodology.ios: Unsigned arm64 iOS executable link with identical -Os/dead_strip flags, measured with file stat and Apple size -m __TEXT.
methodology.abort: Comparison only. panic=abort invalidates the shipping catch_unwind recovery contract.

arm64-v8a.method: actual measured scaffold plus an independent 2.5 MiB design-prior scenario; the scenario is not a bound or probability interval
assumptions: Measured scaffold contribution is the current linked delta, not a prediction of remaining work.
The 2.5 MiB value is the high scenario named by design §5.5; a full port may be smaller or larger.
The 37,850-line reader estimate describes scope and carries no byte-growth law.
